acceptance_criteria: A `Residuals` trait (or equivalent) with: number of residuals, number of parameters, `residuals(&[f64], &mut [f64])`, and an optional analytic `jacobian`; a default forward-difference Jacobian (step ~1e-7 relative) is provided when no analytic one is given.

`solve(problem, &mut params, SolveOptions) -> SolveReport`, where the report has: `converged: bool`, `iterations`, `final_residual_norm`, and a `reason` enum (`Converged`, `MaxIterations`, `Stagnated`, `NonFinite`). `SolveOptions` has defaults: tolerance 1e-10 on the residual norm, 100 max iterations.
LM damping: lambda is increased when a step fails to reduce the residual norm and decreased when it succeeds; a rejected step never changes `params`.

Tests (tolerance 1e-8 on solutions unless stated): (a) linear system x + y = 3, x − y = 1 converges to (2, 1) in ≤ 3 iterations; (b) intersection of circle x²+y²=25 and line y = x + 1 from start (1, 1) converges to (3, 4); (c) the same with the forward-difference Jacobian gives the same solution within 1e-6; (d) an already-satisfied system reports 0 iterations and `Converged`; (e) a consistent but under-determined system (1 equation, 2 unknowns) converges to a point satisfying the equation (residual norm < 1e-10) without panicking; (f) an inconsistent system (x = 0 and x = 1) reports `converged == false` and leaves `params` finite.
Non-finite residuals or parameters return `NonFinite` rather than panicking or looping; dimension mismatches return an error.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-02: Solver core: residual/Jacobian assembly, damped Newton / LM, convergence reporting
